full_judgment: 2. The short fact leading to this petition is that the present petitioners as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 25 of 1986 before the Assistant Judge, Sirajdikhan for cancellation of sale deed dated 17.11.1977 in respect of the proper-ty described in 'Kha' schedule land of the plaint and for recovery of khas possession in respect of 4 decimals of land. Their case is that 'Ka' schedule land belonged to one Budhai Firingi son of Akali Firingi who died leaving behind only son Peter Gomez. This Peter Gomez sold .06 decimal out of plot No. 6 to the plaintiffs by three kabalas dated 7.1.1985 and since then the plain-tiffs are in possession but due to their absence they were dispossessed by the defendants from 'Gha' schedule land after creating certain documents claiming inter-est through defendant No. 2 who claimed to be a grand son of Budhai Firingi. Thereafter the said defendants created certain documents from certain other persons having no interest which have created cloud in the title of the plaintiffs and hence the suit.
